publications.use: Discover procurements published in a period, optionally scoped to municipality.

contracts.use: Discover contracts/empenhos published in a period. Municipality is not a documented filter here; prefer linking contracts from an identified procurement.

detail_api.rule: Use only after a procurement/contract is already identified. No write endpoints, credentials, or maintenance APIs.

privacy_rule: Do not use supplier/person identity to discover property relationships. Link by public project/procurement identifiers, location, object text with explicit locality, or known process/property references.
page_policy: Use conservative page sizes and explicit date windows; do not crawl the entire national corpus by default.
